0.original: A way to obtain fire crystals is on the tip of Iyaate's tongue.

25.original: Survey the designated location and slay any blazing cerule analas that appear for clear fire crystals.

26.original: Survey the designated location and slay any blazing cerule analas that appear for clear fire crystals.

27.original: Deliver the clear fire crystal to Iyaate.

48.original: Right. Time to put my knowledge gained in the First to use.

49.original: Shenza has given me a list of materials. We'll see to it they have everything they need!

50.original: It's a shame Cid and his engineers aren't here to help. If they were here, I expect they'd turn it into a flying train.

51.original: Zoraal Ja's forces remain quiet for now. If there is any movement, I'll alert everyone immediately.

52.original: Iyaate is sure to get you all the fire crystals you'd ever want, and then some.

54.original: You can find them to the south of town. They actually ingest fire crystals and keep them in their gut, if you can believe it!

55.original: If you want the purest crystals, though, you'll have to go after the oldest, toughest analas. Nothing you can't handle, right?

56.original: I'll show you where you can find some to hunt. Looking forward to seeing why Erenville thinks so highly of you.

57.original: There's quite a lot of fiery wildlife in these parts. We think it's due to the ceruleum, but no one can say for sure.

58.original: Still, it's not often that you see the bigger, dominating sort─and that's what you need.

59.original: What you'll have to do is hunt down a few of their kind. Establish yourself as a threat─that's known to draw out the leader.

60.original: That's the spirit! While you're on the hunt, I'll keep watch nearby to make sure no hapless travelers come stumbling in.

61.original: The leaders are certain to show up if you kill a few of the common ones. It's only a matter of when.

62.original: You see no signs of your prey. Perhaps you will have better luck to the south.

63.original: A hefty, cantankerous anala comes lumbering towards you with murderous intent.

64.original: Amazing! You dealt with the beasts in no time at all!

65.original: You need the crystals delivered to Shenza? I'll see that he gets it.

66.original: These fire crystals are for the train, aren't they?

67.original: I heard about your plans to enter the dome.

68.original: I want to thank you for going to such lengths to stop these invaders.

69.original: And though he'd grumble if he knew I was asking this, please take care of Elene'shpya.

70.original: Anyway, I'd best be on my way─and you as well. In case you're going to meet her, I saw Wuk Lamat heading for the station.

71.original: Shenza told me you got the crystals for him. Good work!

72.original: I've just returned from looking for extra help. We'll see in a moment who answers the call!

73.original: All will be in readiness for them when they arrive.

74.original: Dammit... I'm idle for a moment, and all I can think about is my home...

75.original: Keep your chin up, Erenville. We'll be on our way soon, and we'll find your mother.

76.original: It'll be good to see her after all these years. There's so much I'd like to ask her about her time together with Papa.

77.original: Oh, she'll talk your ears off. Once my mother starts, there's no stopping her.

78.original: I wouldn't want it any other way!

79.original: Right, let's return to helping where we can! The real work begins when the extra hands arrive!

80.original: Thanks for making the trek here. To be honest, I wasn't expecting so many of you!

81.original: Since the attack on Tuliyollal, I had been wondering if there was aught I could do to help.

82.original: So when I heard about the upcoming operation from Vow Koana, I leapt at the chance to do my part!

84.original: Peace will be restored, and then we can all enjoy a nice cup of mezcal!

85.original: This is our home, and we'll do whatever it takes to keep it safe.

86.original: While I assist with the efforts here, High Luminary Gurfurlur does the same at the capital.

88.original: With all of us working together, there's nothing we can't accomplish!

89.original: Let's get to it, my friends!

92.original: You've done your part. Leave it to us to finish mounting the armor and cannons, and have yourselves a hard-earned rest.

93.original: Thank you all again for answering the call.

94.original: No need for thanks, now! Whenever you need help, just give us a holler!

95.original: Indeed. We must all do our part when our nation is imperiled.

96.original: Hear, hear! We love Tural, and we love you, Vow Wuk Lamat!

97.original: I love you all too! Your kindness and goodwill will not be in vain, this I promise!

98.original: Taken care of the crystals, have you? Things proceed apace here too.

99.original: Thanks again for all your help. Wouldn't have been able to finish so quickly without you.

100.original: Go and rest up, friend. Won't be long before the train's ready.
